name: My Pet Wizard
original_name: マイペットウィザード
source:
11th episode in My pet Ragnarok series.
Priest Ratchet becomes black merchant's subordinate to satisfy his needs. He keeps obedient sex slave girl. One day he meets genius wizard girl who is looking for the slave girl he owns. What will Ratchet do - keep his favorite toy or give it away to the wizard girl?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
